humanNotes: The file supplied in the repository is named between the lines - demo.mp4; Patrick also referred to the supplied film as Between the lines - 4(1).mp4. The SHA-256 above identifies the actual source used.
Source: H.264, 1080x1920, 24 fps, 92.458667 seconds, 42842998 bytes. Picture ends at 36.291667 seconds; the remaining tail is black.
Eight authored import segments retain source order. The third segment contains the original phone/passenger intercut; these are imported clips, not claims of automatic cut segmentation.

Clips are scaled to 432x768 and full-frame references to 540x960 for the existing combined image budget. No visual objects, text or continuity changes are added or removed. Audio is omitted because the current media pipeline reviews pictures.
Apartment clothing is an authored scene/time transition. This note is human/evaluation-only; no intent action is pre-recorded.
